name: dsh-ai-for-memory
description: Per-conversation layered project memory for DeepSeek Harness, rewritten from ai-game-for-memory: isolated conversation stores, a shared layer, cross-conversation search, process log, archive, snapshots, similarity-based context clearing with restorable archives, context-usage auto tidy, risk-reviewed decisions, and a knowledge base with JSON base files, an optional SQL read-only mirror, RAG retrieval over an OpenAI-compatible embedding/rerank service, and a query router that sends metrics to Text-to-SQL and fuzzy questions to vectors. Test build.
